note: Auto-maintained by scripts/check-file-size-baseline.mjs. Values are frozen upper bounds for first-party source files at or above the soft limit. Without a matching entry in `waivers`, this check never lets a file grow past its bound and `--update` can only lower bounds, add newly-qualifying files, or prune deleted files.
waiverNote: `waivers` is the only sanctioned escape hatch for raising a bound. Each entry needs `max` (the new ceiling, must be >= the intended value) and `reason` (>= 10 chars). Adding one is an explicit, reviewable decision: the diff is the audit trail. Entries whose reason is missing or too short are ignored, and the bound stays frozen.
